title: Views in SQL
definition: A view is a virtual table created using a SELECT query. It does not store data itself but shows data from the base table dynamically.

create_view.heading: Create a View
create_view.query: CREATE VIEW high_salary_employees AS SELECT full_name, department, salary FROM employee WHERE salary > 60000;

update_view.heading: Update / Replace a View
update_view.query: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW high_salary_employees AS SELECT full_name, department, salary FROM employee WHERE salary > 50000;

drop_view.heading: Drop a View
drop_view.note: Dropping a view does not affect the base table.

important_notes.heading: Important Notes
points: A view does not store data
It always shows the latest data from the base table
Views are used to simplify complex queries
